title: New 21 Game
goal: Find the probability a random drawing game stops with score at most n.
strategy: Scores below k continue drawing uniformly from one through maxPts. A sliding sum of active predecessor probabilities supplies each next score; terminal scores accumulate the answer but never generate more draws.
